Moritz Wagner.note: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.

Nolan Traore.note: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

Michael Ajayi.note: Charlotte transferred Ajayi to the G League on Tuesday.

Grayson Allen.note: Allen (concussion) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Nets.

Ryan Kalkbrenner.note: Kalkbrenner (hip) is probable for Saturday's matchup with Brooklyn.

Dennis Schroder.note: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

Kon Knueppel.note: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

Norman Powell.note: Powell (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pacers.

Noa Essengue.note: Essengue (thumb) is probable to play Saturday against the Pacers.

Jalen Smith.note: Smith (illness) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Indiana.

Caleb Wilson.note: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Steven Adams.note: Adams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the 76ers.

Tyrese Haliburton.note: The Pacers recalled Haliburton (hamstring) from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Friday, per the NBA G League transaction report.

T.J. McConnell.note: McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

Ben Sheppard.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Kasparas Jakucionis.note: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

Nikola Topic.note: Topic (hip) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

Aday Mara.note: Mara (leg) is out for Saturday's game versus the Bucks, per Clemente Almanza of USA Today.

Jaylin Williams.note: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

Jalen Williams.note: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

Thomas Sorber.note: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

Cason Wallace.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

Chet Holmgren.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Colin Castleton.note: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

Kevin Porter Jr..note: Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

Anthony Black.note: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.

Jonathan Isaac.note: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

Izaiyah Nelson.note: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Noah Penda.note: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Paolo Banchero.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Dean Wade.note: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.

Joel Embiid.note: Embiid has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Rockets due to right foot plantar fasciitis management, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

LeBron James.note: James (back injury management) won't be available for Saturday's game against the Rockets, according to Kris Rhim of ESPN.

Jaylen Brown.note: Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.

Ariel Hukporti.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Tristan Vukcevic.note: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

Reece Beekman.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

Justin Champagnie.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Jamir Watkins.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
